This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|light blue]] skin with dark stripes on their heads.<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|3}}</ref> a member of this species served as a [[bounty hunter]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild|Guild]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 3: The Sin|third episode]] of the [[2019]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Deborah Chow]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />
